whenToUse: Modal prompts that block the page and ask the user to answer or acknowledge
Confirmations, permission requests and notices that a backdrop click must not close

whenNotToUse.when: A form or settings panel that a click outside may dismiss
A status or warning shown in the page with no decision to make
A modal task with several fields, such as a plan cancellation survey

agentNotes: On the base twin `AlertDialogAction` is a plain `Button` that leaves the dialog open; the radix one closes it on click
`AlertDialogTrigger` takes its button through `render` on the base twin and `asChild` on the radix twin
`size` sm on `AlertDialogContent` sets the footer as 2 equal columns, so keep it to 2 buttons
